meta.title: Understanding Map
meta.description: Summarize your prompts, refresh incrementally, and jump to the original native chat.

empty: Send a message, then refresh to create your map.
hint: Your messages only · Click to return to source
missing: The message has not mounted; navigation is unavailable
outlineHint: Darker blue marks top-level topics. Lighter blue marks deeper topics. Numbers retain conversation order.
timeHint: Deeper topics move right and become lighter. Dashed lines show time order. Solid lines show recorded message relations.
filterLabel: Filter by tags, multiple selections allowed
noMatches: No matching messages. Choose another tag.
